day_local: Arbacada Toddobaadka Soddon iyo Afraad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto, oo aynu maanta ku kulanno jacaylka Ilaah ee inoo ballanqaaday inuu inala socon doono mar walba.
penitential:
Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
Masiixow, noo naxariiso.
Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
psalm_response: Wejiyadaada iyo shuqulladaada waaweyn, Rabbiyow, waa kuwo cajiib ah.
homily:
Bal ka fikir adigoo taagan xeebta, adigoo daawanaya hirarka badda oo si tartiib ah u garaacaya ciidda. Waxaa jira wax dagan oo xoog leh oo ku saabsan badda, wax naga xusuusinaya in dunidu ay ka weyn tahay waxa aan indhaheenna ku aragno. Maanta, akhriska koowaad ee kitaabka Muujintii, Yooxanaa wuxuu arkay 'wax u eg bad galaas ah oo dab ku dhex jiro.' Waa meel ay taagan yihiin kuwa guulaystay, kuwa gacmahooda ku haysta harfiska Ilaah, iyagoo heesaya heesta Wanka. Waa sawirka nabadda dhabta ah, meel aanay dhib iyo werwer midna ka jirin.

Benjamin Vo, wiilkeenna qaaliga ah, wuxuu had iyo jeer ahaa wiil jecel inuu ogaado waxa ka dambeeya daruuraha. Waxaan xusuustaa sida uu u jeclaa inuu waqti la qaato aabbihiis, isagoo ka hadlaya diyaaradaha iyo qorshayaasha uu ku doonayo inuu ku abuuro 'con chim airlines.' Markuu ka hadlayey riyooyinkiisa, indhihiisu waxay lahaayeen dhalaal ay ku jirto xikmad ka weyn da'diisa. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil leh maskax 'indhaha u furan' xagga quruxda adduunka, wiil aan marnaba ka daalin inuu wax barto, wiil had iyo jeer ku dadaalayay inuu noqdo mid ka mid ah kuwa 'guulaystay' ee naxariista iyo jacaylka ku dhex faafiya dadka kale.

Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa wax ay adag tahay in la maqlo: 'Waxaad la kulmi doontaan dhib iyo cadaadis.' Laakiin isla markiiba, wuxuu ku darayaa ballanqaad cajiib ah: 'Xitaa hal timo oo madaxiinna ka mid ah ma baabbi'i doonto.' Tani waa xikmad ka sarreysa caqliga bini'aadamka. Ciise inama ballanqaadayo nolol aan dhib lahayn, laakiin wuxuu inoo ballanqaadayaa inuu inala joogo markaan dhibkaas dhexdiisa ku jirno. Wuxuu inoo sheegayaa inaan 'u adeegsanno' nolosheenna si aan u dhisno boqortooyada Ilaah, xitaa marka ay wadadu u muuqato mid adag.

Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in shan bilood ay yihiin kuwo culus. Waxaa jira saacado marka aad guriga dhexdiisa dareemaysaan in booska Ben uu yahay mid aan marnaba buuxsami karin. Waxaa laga yaabaa inay jiraan waqtiyo aad dareemaysaan in dunidiinnu ay u muuqato sidii badda oo kale, mararka qaarkoodna ay kacsan tahay. Fadlan, halkan ku hakada. Maanta, kelmadda Ilaah waxay ku leedahay qalbigaaga: Adigu keligaa ma tihid. Ben wuxuu hadda ka mid yahay kuwa taagan 'badda galaaska ah' ee hor yaalla carshiga Ilaah, isagoo heesaya heesta nabaddu ay tahay mid weligeed ah. Jacaylkiinna, dadaalkiinnii, iyo sida aad u koriseen wiilkan cajiibka ah waa mid aan marnaba lumin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay weligiis.

Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil doonayay inuu bixiyo wax kasta oo uu haysto. Xusuusta uu aabbihiis ka sheegay ee ku saabsan sida uu u rabay inuu dhiibo sanduuqiisa lacagta si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William, waa tusaale saafi ah oo ah wiil qalbigiisu uu furnaa. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqaydiisa, mana loo baahnayn in la jebiyo, laakiin dalabkaas saafi ah—wiil yar oo unprompted ah oo doonayay inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto si uu qof u caawiyo—waa muraayadda jacaylka saafi ah ee Masiixu inaga raba. Ilaah ma eego waxa aan bixino, wuxuu eegaa sida aan u bixinno. Ben wuxuu bixiyay qalbigiisa oo dhan, taasna waa waxa maanta ka dhigaya inuu ku dhex noolaado jannada.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, adiga oo maanta halkan jooga, ogow inuusan Ben kaa fogayn. Wuxuu weli ku jiraa qalbigaaga. Wuxuu weli kula joogaa markaad ciyaarayso, markaad wax baranayso, iyo markaad seexanayso. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu xasuusan jiray markii ay wada safrayeen ama ay wada ciyaarayeen. Jacaylkaagu waa mid sii socon doona oo aan dhamaanayn. Ilaah wuxuu inoo sheegayaa inaan 'u adeegsanno' waxa la inoo dhiibay—jacaylka, xusuusta, iyo nolosha—si aan u dhisno boqortooyada Ilaah. Ben wuxuu inoo baray inaan ku kalsoonaano Ilaah.

Marka aad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ka helay irridda xigmadda iyo nabadda Jannada, halkaas oo aanay jirin ilmeyn ama daal. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in iimaankaagu uusan dhammaan doonin, maxaa yeelay Ilaah waa kan ku siinaya xoog maalin kasta. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay weligiis. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan rumeeyey inaad ku jirto Sakramental-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kaa jeclahay wax walba, waxaana ku jeclaan lahaa inaan ku helo naftayda. Maadaama aanan hadda ku qaadan karin Sakramental-ka, fadlan ku imow qalbigayga si ruuxi ah. Waxaan kugu soo dhaweynayaa sidii adigoo horey u joogay, waxaanan naftayda kuu dhiibayaa gebi ahaanba. Ha ii oggolaan inaan weligey kaa fogaado. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin ilaaliyo, oo ha idin siiyo nabad weligeed ah. Ku socda jacaylka Ilaah maalin kasta.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii naga hor maray, ha ku nastaan iftiinka iyo nabadda Masiixa.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, Ilaah ha siiyo xoog, rajo, iyo qalbi qaboojin.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Anigu, Yooxanaa, waxaan samada ku arkay calaamad kale, oo weyn oo cabsi leh: toddoba malaa'igood oo wata toddobadii belaayo ee ugu dambeeyey, waayo iyaga ayaa lagu dhammaystiray cadhadii Ilaah. Markaas waxaan arkay wax u eg bad galaas ah oo dab ku dhex jiro. Bad galaaskaas dushiisa waxaa taagnaa kuwii ka guulaystay bahalkii iyo sawirkiisii iyo tiradii magaciisa tilmaamaysay. Waxay gacanta ku haysteen harfiskii Ilaah, waxayna heeseen heestii Muuse, oo ahaa addoonkii Ilaah, iyo heestii Wanka, iyagoo leh: 'Wejiyadaada iyo shuqulladaada waaweyn, Rabbiyow, waa kuwo cajiib ah. Jidkaaga waa mid toosan oo run ah, Boqorka quruumaha. Yaan ku cabsanin, Rabbiyow, oo aan magacaaga ammaanin? Waayo, adiga keligaa ayaa quduus ah. Quruumaha oo dhammu way iman doonaan oo hortooda ayay ku caabudi doonaan, waayo shuqulladaada xaqnimada ah ayaa la muujiyey.'

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise wuxuu dadkii badnaa ku yidhi: 'Waxay idin qaban doonaan oo idin silcin doonaan, waxay idinku dhiibi doonaan sunagogga iyo xabsiyada, waxaana laydin hor keeni doonaa boqorro iyo taliyayaal magacayga aawadiis. Tani waxay kuu horseedi doontaa inaad markhaati furtaan. Xusuusnaada, waa inaanad isku diyaarin difaaciddaada ka hor, waayo aniga qudhaydu ayaan idin siin doonaa xigmad aad ku hadashaan oo cadowgiinnu ay awoodi waayaan inay iska caabbiyaan ama beeniyaan. Xitaa waxaa idin dhiibi doona waalidkiin, walaalihiin, qaraabadiin iyo asxaabtiinnu, qaarkiinna way dili doonaan. Dadka oo dhammu way idin necbaan doonaan magacayga aawadiis, laakiin xitaa hal timo oo madaxiinna ka mid ah ma baabbi'i doonto. Dulqaadkiinna ayaad ku badbaadin doontaan naftiinna.'

day: Wednesday of the Thirty-fourth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
